label: micro-drama
summary: Fast-cut vertical micro-drama: hooks, sharp reactions, cliffhanger endings.
source: Rhythm measured on DramaBoard (2,825 vertical micro-drama episodes, aggregates in dramaboard_rhythm.json).

rhythm.note: cut as soon as a reaction reads; keep the pace up between hooks

camera: static almost always; a follow on entrances; a quick push-in on a reveal
look: bright, high-key and clean; saturated wardrobe that separates rival characters
acting: heightened and readable at phone size: clear expressions, sharp reactions (a gasp, a glare), never mugging
motifs: a hook in the first 3 seconds (a slap, a reveal, a line that poses the question)
a reveal close-up on an object (a ring, a contract, a key)
end on an unresolved beat (cliffhanger), cut on the reaction
do: one beat per shot; cut on the reaction as soon as it reads
dont: no slow establishing sequences; establish in one wide at most
no readable phone screens or documents (text renders badly)
